question: Which Legendre curves in the finished H2 cells have the maximal Hermitian-curve quotient point count (p+1)^2 over F_(p^2)?
method: For each lambda, independently count y^2=x(x-1)(x-lambda) over F_(p^2) by square tests and compare with Sage EllipticCurve.cardinality and (p+1)^2
claim_boundary: The point-count criterion applies to elliptic quotients of the Hermitian plane-section Jacobian; it does not exclude arbitrary correspondences or pointwise encodings from the Hermitian surface
